title: Expose typed library errors
why: An opaque anyhow error in a public library API prevents callers from matching stable error variants without downcasting or inspecting text.
suggestion: Expose a typed error enum from the library and convert it to anyhow only at an application or binary boundary.
limitations: Only public functions owned by publishable Cargo library targets with explicit publication metadata are inspected; application, binary, unpublished, and explicitly internal packages are excluded.
Direct anyhow types and locally declared aliases to anyhow Result or Error are recognized; cross-crate aliases are not resolved.
